title: Standardize credential/retry APIs and unify async stream surface across SDKs
author: Sofia Martinez
commits: feat: introduce RetryProfile and CredProvider interfaces across py/ts/go
fix(python): avoid closing coroutine on generator cancel (stream leak fix)
chore(sdk): bump python->1.14.0, typescript->2.7.0, go->v1.9.3; update changelogs
description: Summary: This PR standardizes credential and retry APIs across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and unifies the async streaming surface to reduce integration friction. Motivation: Divergent retry profiles, token refresh timing, and streaming helper ergonomics across SDKs caused production inconsistencies (reconnect jitter, duplicate reauth flows, different progress semantics) and increased maintenance burden. Implementation: Adds a small cross-SDK compatibility surface: RetryProfile and CredProvider/SessionLease concepts implemented idiomatically in each SDK with identical semantics. Introduces AsyncStream helpers (peek, drain, with_progress) and typed StreamProgress events to make streaming consumers portable. Default retry/backoff profile now matches server-side SLOs (base=100ms, cap=3s, jitter=25%) and a unified token-refresh prefetch (15s minus jitter) to avoid simultaneous mass-refresh on large fleets. Python changes: redwood_sdk.sessions.RetryProfile, session_factory helpers, fix for coroutine closure on generator cancellation, and updated examples. TypeScript changes: async stream utilities in src/stream/asyncStream.ts, stronger credential hook typings, bumped to 2.7.0. Go changes: add RetryProfile interface, session lease implementation in credentials/lease.go, fixes to idle connection timing, bumped to v1.9.3. Migration notes: Default behavior is backwards-compatible for most consumers; new RetryProfile/RetryPolicy can be passed to Client constructors to opt into tuned profiles. The PR includes a migration doc and code examples. Testing: Adds cross-sdk integration matrix and targeted e2e streaming reconnect tests; CI initially hit a flaky streaming integration that failed on first run and passed after a rerun. Rollout plan: staged rollout with TS and Go behind feature flags for one week, then Python rollout and coordinated SDK releases. Risks and mitigations: Slight change in retry timing could surface edge cases; we added smoke tests, monitoring dashboards, and a fast revert plan. Related: Linear ENG-2445 and PM-112; SUP-9812 for an earlier support case. Checklist: - API compat shims implemented - unit + integration tests added - docs updated - release notes included - staged rollout plan prepared.

release_notes: SDKs: Standardized RetryProfile and credential session semantics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Added AsyncStream helpers (peek/drain/with_progress) and StreamProgress typed events. Default retry/backoff tuned to server SLOs; minor SDK version bumps: python 1.14.0, typescript 2.7.0, go v1.9.3. See docs/sdk/migration-auth-retries.md for migration guidance.
notes_on_backcompat: Defaults remain compatible in legacy constructors; to benefit from new profiles pass the new RetryProfile/SessionLease option. All changes are additive except the tuned retry timings which are documented and gated for staged rollout.
egress_notes: Feature-flag gated rollout for TS/Go during week-of 2026-02-22; monitoring dashboards created to watch token refresh rates and streaming reconnects.
